8.37.1. iLock_Geography.switch_types.alterSpecifiedNodes¶

iLock_Geography.switch_types.alterSpecifiedNodes(railyard, nodeIndices, constructor, oldObjType, newObjType, objPath, locked)¶

Function that alters specified nodes.

The nodes are specified by the nodeIndices list. Each node in the list will be replaced by a new node constructed by constructor. All attributes and objects are copied over from the old node in to the new node. The object of subtype oldObjType will have the new subtype newObjType and will have its ATTRIBUTE_PROJECT_TREE_PATH set to objPath. The specified index for each node is used to place the new node correctly in the railyard.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The original railyard
  • nodeIndices ([NodeIndex]) – A list of the nodeindices (node, index) where node is a node that should be altered and index gives information about how the new node should be oriented.
  • constructor (function) – The constructor for the new node.
  • oldObjType (str) – The subtype of a special object (denoting the type of the old node) in each old node.
  • newObjType (str) – The desired subtype of the new copy of the oldObjType object of the old node.
  • objPath (str) – The ATTRIBUTE_PROJECT_TREE_PATH attribute of the new nodes.
  • locked (bool) – true iff the returned railyard is locked
Return type:

IRailyard
Returns:

A locked/unlocked copy of the given railyard in which some specified nodes have been altered to new nodes, specified by the constructor, and in which each object of type oldObjType has been given the new subtype newObjType and the ATTRIBUTE_PROJECT_TREE_PATH objPath.
